claims.text: Used during and after excision to lower recurrence; high complication rate, including scleral and corneal melting
claims.quote: Antimetabolites such as mitomycin and 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) have been used effectively intraoperatively and postoperatively to decrease recurrence rates (1), but they have a high complication rate, including scleral and corneal melting.
